description: This Kotlin source file defines data structures, parsing logic, and helper functions for processing 'talk directives' expressed as JSON within text inputs. It includes classes to represent directives and parsing results, as well as a parser object with a method to parse input text, extract JSON directive objects, and identify unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various configurable parameters of a voice talk directive, including voice ID, model ID, speech speed, and other optional settings.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of parsing, consisting of an optional directive, the remaining text after extraction, and a list of unknown JSON keys.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function that takes a string input, normalizes line endings, identifies a JSON directive at the start, parses it into a TalkDirective object, and returns a TalkDirectiveParseResult containing the directive, the remaining text, and any unknown keys.
